Companies Announce Q1 FY27 Financial Results

Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC), Trent, Hero Motocorp, Lupin, Emcure Pharmaceuticals, Britannia Industries, and Fortis Healthcare are scheduled to announce their Q1 results for the fiscal year 2027 on the current day. Other companies like Bharti Airtel, NBCC, and PB Fintech are also noted as stocks to watch.
